tests.description: 初始化数据库并验证表结构
插入经验后 FTS5 搜索能命中
tests.command: python -c "from scripts.db_ops import insert_knowledge_node, search_knowledge, init_db; db='/tmp/memex-test.db'; from scripts.db_schema import init_db; init_db(db); insert_knowledge_node(db, {'title':'SVG viewBox 测试','category_path':'rendering/coordinate','key_takeaway':'显式设置 viewBox'}); r=search_knowledge(db,'viewBox'); print('OK' if r else 'FAIL')"
python -c "from scripts.sentiment_detector import detect; r=detect('完美！！解决了！就是这样！'); print('OK' if r['signal_type']=='strong_confirm' else r)"

tests.description: 负向信号检测：还是不行
tests.command: python -c "from scripts.sentiment_detector import detect; r=detect('还是不行，一样的问题'); print('OK' if r['polarity']=='negative' else r)"

tests.description: TrueSkill 评分更新：confirm→μ上升，failure→μ下降
tests.command: python -c "from scripts.rating_engine import LessonRating; r=LessonRating(); print(f'init: μ={r.mu:.1f}'); r.apply_signal('confirm', 0.9); print(f'after_confirm: μ={r.mu:.1f}'); r.apply_signal('failure', 0.8, 0.7); print(f'after_failure: μ={r.mu:.1f}'); print('OK' if r.mu < 28 else 'FAIL')"

tests.description: TrueSkill 连续颗粒度：50次不同于3次
tests.command: python -c "from scripts.rating_engine import LessonRating; r1=LessonRating(); r2=LessonRating(); [r1.apply_signal('confirm', 1.0) for _ in range(50)]; [r2.apply_signal('confirm', 1.0) for _ in range(3)]; print(f'50次: μ={r1.mu:.1f} σ={r1.sigma:.1f}'); print(f'3次: μ={r2.mu:.1f} σ={r2.sigma:.1f}'); print('OK' if r1.mu > r2.mu and r1.sigma < r2.sigma else 'FAIL')"
